title: Programul „Diaspora Investește Acasă”

who: Press release from the Romanian Ministry of Finance announcing the "Diaspora Investește Acasă" program, which allocates €100 million to finance businesses newly established by Romanians living abroad who want to invest in Romania.
fit_reason: The source focuses on diaspora investment in general business ventures (grants for newly founded firms), not on individuals building, renovating, or planning a personal house in Romania. While some diaspora entrepreneurs might eventually construct facilities, the lead does not show a clear signal of residential construction activity, making it a poor match for the ICP.
